description: This is a test module for the EnterpriseRouteChecks class, specifically testing route management logic and exception handling in the context of enterprise authentication and routing within the litellm project.

classes.name: TestEnterpriseRouteChecks
classes.description: Test suite for EnterpriseRouteChecks, focusing on route accessibility based on management and LLM API route states.

methods.name: test_should_call_route_management_disabled( self, mock_is_management_route, mock_is_management_disabled )
methods.description: Verifies that when management routes are disabled and the route is a management route, an HTTP 403 exception is raised.

methods.name: test_should_call_route_llm_api_disabled( self, mock_is_management_route, mock_is_llm_api_route, mock_is_management_disabled, mock_is_llm_api_disabled, )
methods.description: Verifies that when LLM API routes are disabled and the route is an LLM API route, an HTTP 403 exception is raised.

methods.name: test_should_call_route_both_disabled_management_takes_priority( self, mock_is_management_route, mock_is_llm_api_route, mock_is_management_disabled, mock_is_llm_api_disabled, )
methods.description: Ensures that if both management and LLM API routes are disabled, the management route restriction takes precedence.

methods.name: test_should_call_route_enabled( self, mock_is_management_route, mock_is_llm_api_route, mock_is_management_disabled, mock_is_llm_api_disabled, )
methods.description: Confirms that when routes are enabled, no exceptions are thrown for various route types.

methods.name: test_should_call_route_management_disabled_llm_enabled( self, mock_is_management_route, mock_is_llm_api_route, mock_is_management_disabled, mock_is_llm_api_disabled, )
methods.description: Tests that LLM API routes are accessible when only management routes are disabled.

methods.name: test_should_call_route_llm_disabled_management_enabled( self, mock_is_management_route, mock_is_llm_api_route, mock_is_management_disabled, mock_is_llm_api_disabled, )
methods.description: Tests that management routes are accessible when only LLM API routes are disabled.
